plain.li: There's the one that looks like a plow.
I could stay out here half the night.
You forget how many there are until you look up.
That bright one wasn't there last week, was it?
[winter] Cold enough to freeze my ears, and worth it.
[lowtech] My grandmother had a name for every one of these.
[!lowtech] Somebody up there is flying between them right now.

warm.li: Come and look, if you're still awake.

cheerful.li: I counted forty before I lost my place, and started over!

gloomy.li: They'll still be up there long after we're gone.

cold.li: Clear sky, no moon; good for reckoning the season.

plain.li: Come on, you can do better than that.
You're coming along nicely, aren't you?
Drink up, there's a dry week coming.
Don't mind the beetles, I'll see to them.
Look at you, standing up straight at last.
[winter] Hold on, it isn't long till spring.
[spring] Up you come, the frost is done with.

cheerful.li: Every one of you is doing beautifully!

gloomy.li: Don't die on me like the last lot.

cold.li: Yellow at the tips; more water, less sun.

plain.li: Easy now, it's only me.
There, that's the spot, isn't it?
Somebody's been rolling in the mud again.
Did they remember to feed you, or shall I ask?
[named] Hello, {OTHER_nameDef}, how's your day been?
[named] Who's the best of the lot, {OTHER_nameDef}?
[bonded] You and me, same as always.
[young] Look how big you've got already.

warm.li: You're the best of us, and you know it.

blunt.li: Sit still, I'm checking your feet.

gloomy.li: At least you don't mind my company.

cold.li: Coat's good, eyes are clear; you'll do.

plain.li: Enough for a while, I think, if nobody gets greedy.
I'll count it again tomorrow, just to be sure.
Who keeps moving things about in here?
Forty-two, forty-three, and one gone soft.
[winter] It'll last till the thaw, if the thaw comes on time.
[!lowtech] Somebody ought to write all this down properly.
[lowtech] Notches on the post, one for every sack, and two missing.

warm.li: We'll be all right, there's enough here.

cheerful.li: More than last month, that's a start!

gloomy.li: One bad harvest and this is all gone.

cold.li: Three weeks at this rate, less in a cold snap.

plain.li: Mind if I sit with you a while?
Quiet day, isn't it?
I didn't fancy sitting on my own again.
Tell me something, anything, it's been a long week.
[partner] Stay a bit, I've hardly seen you all week.
[kin] Sit with me, like we used to.
[guest] Where is it you've come from, if you don't mind me asking?
[guest] How are you finding it here?

warm.li: It's good to have someone to talk to.

cheerful.li: There you are, I was hoping I'd find you!

gloomy.li: Sorry, I just didn't want to be on my own.

cold.li: Talk helps, I find; you needn't say much.

plain.li: Did I ever tell you about the winter the river froze?
Back home we'd sit just like this, every night.
There was a woman in my village who could whistle down a hawk.
When I was young, a night like this would have been a feast.
[lowtech] My father told this one by the fire, so I will too.
[!lowtech] We had a radio once, and nobody ever listened to it.

warm.li: Come closer, this one's a good one.

blunt.li: Old story, sit down and listen.

cheerful.li: Oh, you'll like this one, it's got a goat in it!

gloomy.li: Most of the people in this story are gone now.

cold.li: I'll tell it the way it happened, not the way it's told.

plain.li: I had the oddest dream last night, let me tell you.
Pass the salt, and let me tell you what I dreamt.
[dream:Sweet] In my dream we had a whole orchard, and all of it ripe.
[dream:Sweet] I dreamt about home last night, only the good parts.
[dream:Strange] The river ran uphill in my dream, and we all just watched it go.
[dream:Strange] I dreamt I was a door, of all things.
[dream:Nightmare] Bad dream last night, I won't tell it over breakfast.
[dream:Nightmare] Dreamt the walls were gone and there was a thing out there, waiting.
[dream:Omen] A black bird sat on our roof in my dream, and I didn't like it.
[dream:Omen] I had a dream I think means something, so don't laugh.
[dream:Lost] I saw them again last night, in the dream, just as they were.
[dream:Lost] They were sitting at this table in my dream, laughing.

warm.li: [dream:Sweet] Such a lovely dream, I didn't want to wake up.

blunt.li: Dreamt something, forget it, eat your porridge.

cheerful.li: You'll never guess what I dreamt last night!

gloomy.li: Same dream again, the one I never tell.

cold.li: Dreams are the day sorting itself out, but this one was odd.

plain.li: Someone's coming up the road with packs on.
Looks like we'll have neighbors for a while.
Strangers on the track, and they're not hurrying.
[camp:Hunters] Hunters, by the look of them, and hungry ones.
[camp:Refugees] They've got everything they own on their backs.
[camp:Market] Traders, and a cart that wants a new wheel.
[camp:Players] Is that a drum I can hear?
[camp:Healers] Healers, I think, there's a red cloth on the cart.
[camp:Pilgrims|camp:Procession] Pilgrims, singing as they walk.
[camp:Prospectors|camp:Surveyors] They've brought picks and a great deal of rope.
[camp:Hermit] Just the one of them, walking slow.
[camp:Smith] A smith, by the anvil on that cart.

blunt.li: Company coming, keep an eye on them.

gloomy.li: More mouths near our stores, that's all.

cold.li: A small group, coming in slow; not a raid.

plain.li: To {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef}, with the council's blessing.
[councillor] The council wishes you both a long life together.
[councillor] Ring it again, it isn't every day.
[councillor,promised] We said there'd be a wedding, and here it is.
[friend] Even the council came out for this one.
[promised] The council kept its word, and here they are.
[officer] One of the council married, who'd have thought it.

warm.li: Look at the two of them, I could cry.

cheerful.li: Ring the bell, ring it again!

gloomy.li: Enjoy it, both of you, while it's quiet.

cold.li: Witnessed and written down; it's done.

plain.li: Nice place, smaller than I expected.
Your people all seem to know what they're doing.
[happy] I could get used to this place.
[happy] Good food, and nobody's tried to rob me yet.
[unhappy] I've had warmer welcomes in a bandit camp.
[unhappy] I'll be glad to be back on the road.
[roomgood] They gave me a proper room, lamp and all.
[roompoor] My bed's in a corner with a draught through it.
[nobed] Nobody's said where I'm to sleep tonight.
[gathering] Your people know how to keep a feast.
[gathering] Is this for anything, or do you just like a party?

warm.li: Thank you for having us, truly.

cheerful.li: Wait till I tell them back home about this!

gloomy.li: Just passing through, don't mind me.

cold.li: A well-run place; I'll say as much when I'm home.

plain.li: [race] I'm not what I was. I keep catching sight of myself in the water and stopping to look.
[race] Everything fits differently now: the doorways, the chairs, my own hands. The others are being kind about it.
[xeno] The change has taken. I feel it in my blood, or I think I do. I'm still me underneath, mostly.
[xeno] I woke up a different kind of person today. Breakfast tasted the same, which was a relief.
[bigger] I've grown. I hit my head on the lintel twice this morning, and the second time everyone laughed.
[smaller] I'm smaller than I was. The table comes up higher and the walk to the fields takes longer.

warm.li: [race] The others keep asking how I am. Different, I tell them, and still glad to be here.
[xeno] Someone made me a cup of tea and sat with me while I got used to it. That helped more than anything.

blunt.li: [race] New body. Takes getting used to. Getting used to it.
[xeno] Different blood now. Same work to do.

cheerful.li: [race] A whole new me! I keep finding things this body can do that the old one couldn't.
[bigger] I can reach the top shelf now, and I've been asked to reach a great many things.

gloomy.li: [race] I don't recognize myself. I don't know if the others do either.
[xeno] They say I'll get used to it. I'm not sure I want to.

cold.li: [xeno] The change is complete. I'll learn what it's good for.
[smaller] Smaller frame, less food, same work. It's a fair trade.
